name: Great Bear Spirit

angles.text: As a druid, you commune with the Great Bear Spirit to gain natural wisdom and the spiritual grounding needed to take on the bear’s resilience.

faq.answer: The Great Bear Spirit dwells in the northwestern wilds of Moonglade, apart from Nighthaven and its settled paths.
faq.q: Where can the Great Bear Spirit be found?

aliases: who sends you to bear spirit
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze, an elder druid in Nighthaven, directs initiates to commune with the spirit as part of their natural training.
faq.q: Who sends druids to seek out the Great Bear Spirit?

faq.answer: The Great Bear Spirit is a wise and noble guide, tutor, and mentor who teaches practicing druids the primal nature of the bear.
faq.q: What is the Great Bear Spirit?

aliases: what do you learn from bear spirit
faq.answer: Initiates commune with the spirit to learn the bear’s nature and take in its raw strength, resilience, and wisdom before returning to put those qualities to work.
faq.q: Why must druids commune with the Great Bear Spirit?

faq.answer: After communing with the spirit, initiates return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven. Dendrite recognizes their new understanding and prepares them to focus that power.
faq.q: What happens after the Great Bear Spirit is satisfied?

aliases: do all druids visit bear spirit
faq.answer: Every druid must seek the Great Bear Spirit’s counsel. Communion is a fundamental step toward attuning to animal forms and natural power.
faq.q: Do all druids need to seek the spirit's wisdom?

sections.body: In northwestern Moonglade, the Great Bear Spirit dwells apart from Nighthaven’s quiet paths. This ancient and noble mentor teaches every initiate who seeks to understand the bear’s nature. Druids have long sought its blessing and wisdom as part of the path of the wild.
sections.title: The Noble Mentor of Moonglade

sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze guides young druids from Nighthaven into the hills to meet the spirit. Communion brings primal wisdom and an awareness of natural strength. When the druids return, Dendrite tests their focus. The encounter gives them raw strength and knowing intent, but they must learn to direct that power in their daily work.
sections.title: A Rite of Primal Focus

summary: In Moonglade, druids are sent north to seek the Great Bear Spirit. Communion with this ancient guide teaches the bear’s nature and strength, a vital part of a druid’s spiritual and martial training.
attribution: In-game quest text: Great Bear Spirit
